messages:
Alex: noticed a sustained bump in tiny-infer pod Pending & Preempted in us-west2a starting 02:15. latency SLOs for small QPS workloads affected.
Priya: what do the scheduler traces show?
Alex: several nodes saturated on `gpu.memory` but low overall CPU. packing shows a skew: scheduler is co-locating many 1-GPU, high-seqlen tasks onto the same rack labeled `nvlink=true`. small 1GPU jobs kept getting kicked to spot nodes then preempted.
Daniel: that matches an earlier heuristic change: we prioritized `nvlink=true` affinity to favor long-seq throughput. downside is creating hot racks and fragmentation elsewhere.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-west2a rack-7 warmpool < 20% at 8476543302. preempt_count: 96 in 20m.
Priya: quick fixes: 1) add anti-affinity soft rule for small pods so they spread across racks (fast), 2) temporarily relax `nvlink` affinity (requires a small rollout), 3) increase warmpool min for the AZ.
Alex: I can push the anti-affinity mutator now: label selector `gpu==1 && annotations.seq_len < 800` -> add `scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/affinity: spread`.
Daniel: also bumping warmpool: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west2a -p '{"spec":{"minSize":140}}'`. doing it now.
infra-bot: ACTION: anti-affinity mutator applied at 8476543430. warmpool patch accepted at 8476543450.
Priya: preliminary metrics: pending queue halved, preempt events dropping. NVLink error logs still show spikes for a few pods — likely stragglers on rack-7.
SRE Oncall: follow-ups: 1) add a per-rack `seq_len_skew` metric; 2) make `nvlink` affinity a topology-hint not a hard preference; 3) revisit warmpool sizing algorithm to account for pod shape mix.
Alex: filing ticket with traces and suggested changes. will monitor for 2 hours then close. :thumbsup:
